responsibility: Declares the public interface for Ada spec dumping from the C-family front ends. It defines the small callback protocol used by c-ada-spec.cc to ask the C++ front end about language-specific properties of tree nodes, and exposes the entry points for collecting source references and dumping all gathered declarations as Ada specs.
same_name_distinction: Interface header for the Ada spec dumper: it defines the cpp_operation callback protocol and declares collect/dump entry points used by front ends, while c-ada-spec.cc provides the actual Ada syntax generation, macro handling, and file-writing logic.
